description: List insurance groups with licensed entities in two or more countries across Africa, Europe, Asia-Pacific, South America and North America, with their footprint.

continent.description: Only groups with entities on this continent.

iaig.description: true: only groups controlled by an Internationally Active Insurance Group (IAIS register); false: only groups that are not.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

name: list_groups

outputSchema.description: A JSON envelope. Successful results carry dataset, version, verified and licence plus the tool’s data; failures carry error, code and retryable.

verified.description: Date the dataset snapshot was verified.

version.description: Dataset version the result was read from.

title: List multi-country insurance groups
